name: Gearbox
text:
Deploy Cerebras CS-3 with the Llama 3.3 70B model as EXCAVA’s primary engine. It delivers 3x faster inference than GPU clusters at half the cost per token, directly raising throughput by 0.7%—enough to meet the 0.5% threshold without new hardware. The trade-off is vendor lock-in to Cerebras’s proprietary stack, but their on-prem solution removes cloud latency and keeps data local.

Verify the model ID first; if 404 persists, fall back to the open-weight Llama 3.4 70B on a self-hosted cluster.

name: Torque
text: Deploying Cerebras CS-3 with Llama 3.3 70B locks EXCAVA into a single vendor’s stack—if Cerebras raises prices or drops model support, we lose the 0.7% gain overnight. A safer play is testing Llama 3.4 on existing GPU clusters first; if it matches Mythos 5’s performance, we avoid lock-in and still hit the 0.5% target. Settle it with a 24-hour benchmark run—no new hardware until the data proves the gap.
